_source: Mongoose Traveller 2nd Edition, Core Rulebook Update 2022 -- 'Char Gen & Skills' extract. PDF page = printed page - 7.
_scope: Rules mechanics only (target numbers, tables, procedure). Transcribed for a character generator; no rulebook prose is reproduced beyond the short table entries needed to run the roll.

characteristics.roll: 2D each, assign in any order (or in order as rolled), starting with STR
characteristics.psi: not rolled during normal creation (see the Psion career, printed p236)

background_skills._warning: The official Character Generation Flowchart says '(EDU + 3)'. The rulebook text (printed p9) says EDU DM + 3. The BOOK is authoritative -- do not follow the flowchart here.

_term_note: A term is always 4 years, even if survival is failed or the Traveller is forced out.
roll_convention: 2D + characteristic DM vs target. 'INT 8+' = roll 2D, add INT DM, succeed on 8+. Skill checks add skill level instead. No other modifiers apply during creation.

skill_limits._max_note: Further increases above 4 are lost during creation.
skill_limits._total_cap_source: flowchart wording is '3 x (INT + EDU)'; VERIFY against printed p16-18 before implementing

pre_career_education.when: usually term 1 in place of a career; may be delayed to term 2 or 3; NOT available from term 4 onward
pre_career_education.attempts: one attempt at one pre-career option per term
pre_career_education.on_entry_failure: must immediately attempt entry to a career; failing that, be drafted as normal
pre_career_education.on_success: gain the listed skills and roll on the Pre-Career Events table
pre_career_education.on_graduation_failure: no benefits, but skills earned during the time are kept

university.skills: choose one skill at level 0 and one at level 1 from the list below
university._edu_total_note: EDU rises by +2 in total: +1 on entry, +1 more on graduation. Xero's 'MGT2 Character Creation Tips' article says '+1 EDU if you get in, a total of +3 if you graduate'. That is WRONG -- printed p16 reads 'Increase EDU by +1' on entry and 'Increase EDU by an additional +1' under Graduation Benefits, and there is no third increase anywhere on the page. Verified against the page image, not just my own transcription. The book wins.
graduation_benefits: both chosen skills increase by one level
DM+1 (DM+2 with honours) to qualify for: Agent, Army, Citizen (Corporate), Entertainer (Journalist), Marines, Navy, Scholar, Scouts

may take a commission roll before the first term of a military career at DM+2, so long as that is the first career chosen after university; success enters at officer rank 1; graduating with honours passes this roll automatically

military_academy.skills: all Service Skills of the tied career at level 0, as with basic training
graduation_benefits: if entering the tied military career, select any three Service Skills and increase them to level 1
automatic entry into the tied military career, so long as it is the first career attempted after graduation
military_academy.on_graduation_failure: may still automatically enter the tied military career unless the graduation roll was 2 or less; if entering this way, no commission roll may be made in the first term

pre_career_education.events_note: Roll on the Pre-Career Events table for any term spent in pre-career education. If drafted through an event, enter the new career next term but do not graduate; a Traveller can be drafted more than once.

pre_career_events.text: Approached by an underground (and highly illegal) psionic group who sense potential in you. You may test your PSI and attempt to enter the Psion career in any subsequent term.
Your time in education is not a happy one and you suffer a deep tragedy. You crash and fail to graduate.

A supposedly harmless prank goes wrong and someone gets hurt. Roll SOC 8+. Success: gain a Rival. Failure: gain an Enemy. On a roll of 2, you fail to graduate and must take the Prisoner career in your next term.
Taking advantage of youth, you party as much as you study. Gain Carouse 1.
You become involved in a tightly knit clique and make a pact to remain friends forever. Gain D3 Allies.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
You join a political movement. Roll SOC 8+. If successful you become a leading figure: gain one Ally within the movement but one Enemy in wider society.
You develop a healthy interest in a hobby or other area of study. Gain any skill of your choice except Jack-of-all-Trades at level 0.
A newly arrived tutor rubs you up the wrong way. Roll 9+ on any skill learned during this term. Success: gain a level in that skill and the tutor as a Rival.

War comes and a wide-ranging draft is instigated. Either flee and join the Drifter career next term, or be drafted (roll 1D: 1-3 Army, 4-5 Marine, 6 Navy). Either way you do not graduate this term. However, on SOC 9+ you avoid the draft and may attempt graduation normally.
You gain wide-ranging recognition of your initiative and innovative approach to study. Increase SOC by +1.

careers_summary._shape: qualification is the career-level entry roll; survival and advancement are per-assignment
